# nico_credential_rotation (Data Source)

Credential Rotation endpoints stage a site-wide credential rotation and report per-Site or per-device convergence

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_credential_rotation" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "credential_rotation_name" {
  value = data.nico_credential_rotation.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `credential_type` (String) Credential family to report.
- `device_mac` (String) Report only this device's convergence, matched by MAC.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site to query.

### Read-Only

- `complete` (Boolean) True only when every device in the queried set has reached the target with none pending and none quarantined.
- `converged` (Number) Number of devices at or beyond the target version.
- `device` (Attributes) Per-device convergence detail, returned only for a MAC-targeted status query. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--device))
- `pending` (Number) Number of devices not yet converged and eligible to rotate.
- `quarantined` (Number) Number of devices currently in a rotation backoff window.
- `quarantined_device_macs` (List of String) MAC addresses of the quarantined devices.
- `started` (String) When the current target version was staged.
- `target_version` (Number) Current site-wide target version for this family.

<a id="nestedatt--device"></a>
### Nested Schema for `device`

Read-Only:

- `converged` (Boolean) True once the current version reaches the site-wide target.
- `current_version` (Number) Credential version live on the hardware. Null when not yet established.
- `device_mac` (String) The device this status describes.
- `last_attempted` (String) When the last rotation attempt ran; null if none.
- `last_error` (String) Redacted last-error string for observability; never a secret.
- `quarantined` (Boolean) True while the device is in a rotation backoff window.
- `quarantined_until` (String) When the current backoff window expires; set only while quarantined.
- `rotate_attempts` (Number) Number of rotation attempts recorded for this device.
- `rotating_to_version` (Number) Set while a rotation is mid-flight on this device.
